v7-3.display:
All Israel’s sons saw the fire descending and the Lord’s glory upon the house. They fell face down to the earth upon the stone pavement, worshiped, and praised the Lord:
“For it is good,
for His mercy endures for ever.”

v7-6.display:
The priests stood at their watches, and the Levites had instruments for the Lord’s songs belonging to King David, to give thanks before the Lord,
“For His mercy endures for ever,”
with David’s hymns through their hands. The priests sounded trumpets on the trumpets opposite them, while all Israel stood.
